studies.notes: The main extraction record is s1_novelty_gpt_vs_hum_paired_lmm, the paired GPT-versus-HUM originality comparison in PDF p. 4, Section 4.1. Neither its model description in Section 4 nor its result in Section 4.1 prints the number of participants analyzed or exact per-condition analyzed counts. The Bayesian re-estimation also prints no analysis-specific participant count. The enrollment and overall dataset counts do not establish the main model count, so n_analyzed remains null. The n_randomized fields record the printed enrolled cohort whose condition order was randomized. GPT, HUM, and CON (pooled) contain the same within-person cohort; people are counted once at study level. Figure 3 reports participant counts separately by BAS Drive subgroup and condition. The high-Drive GPT count differs from the corresponding HUM and CON counts without an exclusion explanation. These printed labels are retained individually in other_counts and are not added to reconstruct a main-model count. The figure note identifies its observations as individual participant means and its contrasts as Welch t-tests on subject-level means. The CON seed-set boxes give only approximate counts, not exact analyzed or enrolled counts; their assignment is not stated to be random, and Section 4.3 calls it uneven. The later-session seed-set analysis prints no participant count. No participant count is inferred from degrees of freedom, ideas, ratings, or arithmetic. All of the markdown conversion and all PDF pages, including figure notes and references, were read; the three embedded figures were inspected in memory. Figure 3 count labels and Figure 1 approximate seed-set counts are embedded image text and are not present in the PDF text layer. The supplied author manuscript contains no appendix or named supplement, and the extraction source names no supplement. The later proceedings version identified by the citation record was not used.
